speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of gait and limb ataxia, have you noticed any episodes of vision loss or numbness in your extremities? REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain and Spine.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML).

speaker: Doctor
text: That MRI result is concerning for PML, but given your initial history of gait and limb ataxia, let's clarify the timeline: did you experience any episodes of numbness or weakness that resolved over days to weeks before these symptoms started? REQUEST TEST: CSF Analysis for Oligoclonal Bands.

speaker: Doctor
text: Doctor: Since the MRI showed demyelinating lesions and your CSF is normal, do you recall any specific triggers for your ataxia, such as heat exposure or infection, and have you noticed any sensory changes like tingling in your hands or feet? REQUEST IMAGES: Please show me the specific location and appearance of the T2 hyperintensities on your brain MRI.

text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.
